name: Touchtry RoomFit
author: touchtry

sections.description:
Touchtry RoomFit AR helps WooCommerce furniture stores launch product AR experiences using Touchtry links.

This plugin adds a “Try On” button on WooCommerce single product pages. Merchants can save a product-specific AR link from the WooCommerce product editor. If no custom AR link is saved, the plugin can fall back using the product SKU or product ID.

Current Features:

  • WooCommerce single product page integration
  • Product-level Furniture AR Try-On Link field
  • Product-specific AR launch button
  • HTTPS AR link support
  • SKU / Product ID fallback link behavior
  • Admin dashboard with setup, integration guide, pricing, and support tabs
  • Responsive frontend button styling

External services

This plugin loads tutorial videos from YouTube in the admin dashboard upload tab.
When viewing that tab, the admin browser requests the video directly from YouTube servers.

  • YouTube Terms of Service: https://www.youtube.com/t/terms
  • YouTube Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Credits

Developed by the Touchtry Team
For support, visit: https://touchtry.com/#my-contact
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/touchtry-roomfit, or install via the WordPress plugin dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Open any WooCommerce product in the admin panel.
  5. Add the product AR link in the Furniture AR Try-On Link field.
  6. Save the product and open the product page to test the Try On button.
sections.faq:
Is it compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin is designed for WooCommerce product pages.

Where do I add the AR link?

Open a WooCommerce product and use the Furniture AR Try-On Link field.

What happens if I do not add a custom AR link?

The plugin can fall back using the product SKU or product ID.

Can I customize the Try On button?

Yes. You can style the button using your theme or plugin CSS.

Does this plugin include a shortcode or Gutenberg block?

No. The current version is focused on WooCommerce product-page integration.

Does it show a QR code on desktop?

No desktop QR code feature is included in the current version.
